content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-working-3|COREMERCH guide to digital]]-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-what-actually-3|digital]] creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya face a common problem: conventional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or severely restricted. This leaves them unable to collect [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-every-detail-you-4|Tron USDT]] for their digital products—ebooks, courses, templates, and more. Google Apps Script, however, offers a robust solution. By integrating it with crypto payment processors like NOWPayments, creators can automate digital product delivery without relying on restricted platforms. This breakdown explains how to build a sovereign commerce stack using Google Apps Script, ensuring you own your infrastructure and control your sales pipeline.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based JavaScript platform that automates tasks within Google Workspace. For digital commerce, it acts as the backend logic layer, processing orders, verifying payments, and triggering product delivery. Unlike platforms like Stripe, it doesn’t require KYC or depend on regional availability. Paired with NOWPayments for crypto payment verification, it creates a fully automated system. This setup ensures that once a payment confirms on-chain, the buyer receives their download link instantly—no manual intervention required. The result is a sovereign stack that operates independently of restricted payment gateways, giving creators in underserved regions full control over their sales process.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture begins with a payment webhook from NOWPayments. When a buyer sends cryptocurrency, NOWPayments verifies the transaction and sends a webhook to your Google Apps Script. The script processes this event, checks the payment status, and updates the order in Google Sheets or Supabase. If the payment is confirmed, the script generates a download link for the product, hosted on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and sends it via email using Gmail or Resend. This pipeline ensures orders are processed in under 30 seconds. The system is stateless, meaning it scales automatically without additional infrastructure costs, making it ideal for creators of all sizes.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are inaccessible or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, or software and cannot use Stripe, PayPal, or similar services, this stack gives you a fully operational online store. It’s also for creators who value infrastructure sovereignty—owning their tools instead of renting them. By deploying this stack, you eliminate dependency on third-party platforms, avoid subscription fees, and retain full control over your data and customer relationships. It’s built to withstand financial isolation and currency collapse, as proven in pressure-tested environments like Zimbabwe.
A correctly configured sovereign stack processes orders in under 30 seconds—no manual intervention required.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack consists of Google Apps Script for backend logic, Google Sheets or Supabase for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file hosting, NOWPayments for crypto payment verification, and Gmail or Resend for delivery emails. Google Apps Script acts as the central orchestrator, connecting these components. NOWPayments handles over 300 cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC, making it accessible to buyers worldwide. Cloudflare R2 offers cost-effective file storage, while Supabase provides scalable order management. Together, these tools form a resilient, low-cost commerce infrastructure that operates without regional restrictions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this stack, start by setting up a NOWPayments account and configuring a webhook to your Google Apps Script. Write the script to listen for payment events, verify transactions, and update order status in Google Sheets or Supabase. Host your digital products on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and configure the script to generate download links. Use Gmail or Resend to send these links automatically. Test the pipeline end-to-end to ensure seamless operation. For a turnkey solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours with 30-day support.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery with crypto payments works by integrating a payment processor like NOWPayments with a backend script like Google Apps Script. When a buyer sends cryptocurrency, NOWPayments verifies the transaction and sends a webhook to the script. The script checks the payment status, updates the order, and generates a download link for the product. This link is then sent to the buyer via email, all within 30 seconds. The process is fully automated, requires no manual intervention, and operates independently of traditional payment platforms.

1. Set up a NOWPayments account and configure a webhook to your Google Apps Script. 2. Write the script to listen for payment events, verify transactions, and update order status in Google Sheets or Supabase. 3. Host your digital products on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 4. Configure the script to generate download links for confirmed payments. 5. Use Gmail or Resend to automatically send these links to buyers. 6. Test the entire pipeline end-to-end to ensure seamless operation. 7. Deploy the stack to production and monitor performance. Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a turnkey solution deployed in 48 hours, requiring no coding. It includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, with 30-day support. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, USDT, and Solana. It charges a 0.5% fee per transaction, with no KYC required for buyers or sellers, making it accessible globally.
How secure is the delivery email?
The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, ensuring your delivery emails are authenticated and secure. This prevents spoofing and increases deliverability rates.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?

Yes, the stack is designed to scale. Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier, and Supabase provides scalable order storage. The infrastructure grows with your business.
What happens if a payment fails?

The script checks payment status and only triggers delivery for confirmed transactions. If a payment fails, the order remains pending, and no download link is sent. The system is stateless and requires no manual intervention.
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhook firing.
